{{Quote|This wayward droid contains highly sensitive information concerning the personal affairs on an unnamed politician. Return or destroy.|TC-9D0's bounty brief|<ref name="Prima" />}}
'''TC-9D0''' was a [[TC-series protocol droid/Legends|TC-series protocol droid]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with [[Color/Legends|gray]] plating and yellow [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]]. He<ref name="Prima" /> was manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]<ref name="Corresponding" /> and was affiliated with [[linguist]]s and other [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]].<ref name="Prima" /> At some point by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> sensitive information regarding the personal affairs of a [[Politics/Legends|politician]] had become stored within TC-9D0's [[Memory circuit/Legends|memory circuits]]. A special branch of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|senatorial guard]] placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], offering 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for his retrieval, or 1,500 for his [[Death/Legends|destruction]].<ref name="Prima" />

{{GameMechanics}}
In 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> TC-9D0 was covered in brown gunk and was present in [[Merchant Row (Outland Station)|Merchant Row]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Outland Transit Station|Outland Station]]. During the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] pursuit of the criminal [[Meeko Ghintee]], the hunter captured TC-9D0 for the full sum of credits.<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
TC-9D0 first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', developed by [[LucasArts]]. In the game, the protocol droid is the first optional secondary bounty that the player can capture in Merchant Row and is the sixth overall. TC-9D0 is able to be captured by the player for a higher sum of credits or destroyed for a lower amount.<ref name="BH" /> This article assumes that TC-9D0 was captured functional for the full sum of credits.
